_doc.milestone: The stage the opens are logged under and the routed calls' spending is booked under (docs/plan.md, 里程碑; docs/m6-计划.md): M6, the third and last open.
_doc.purpose: What the opens are for. Each open's line in data/eval/test-access.jsonl and data/eval/e2e-test-access.jsonl states it, followed by the git commit and this file's SHA-256.
_doc.systems: The systems the session runs, from ft, b0, b1, ftr, ft2, ft2r, b4 and b2, in that order whatever the list's. M6 runs ft2 (FT2) then ft2r (FT2+R2) on the server with the ft2 adapter; FT, B2 and FT+R are not run again (reference).
_doc.adapters: The adapter of the server of every local system run: ft2 for ft2 and ft2r.
_doc.adapters.<system>: One adapter: its GGUF, the GGUF's SHA-256 and the selection that chose it.
_doc.adapters.<system>.gguf: The GGUF the system's llama-server loads, relative to the repository root.
_doc.adapters.<system>.sha256: The GGUF's SHA-256, 64 lower-case hex digits; the preflight refuses a file with another, and the routing file must record the same.
_doc.adapters.<system>.selection: The checkpoint selection whose chosen GGUF and SHA-256 these must be, relative to the repository root.
_doc.server: The llama-server of the local systems (research_agent.llm.server.LocalServer: -ngl 99, --jinja, 127.0.0.1, no prompt cache, one slot: scripts/run_test.py SLOTS), as in M3 and M5.
_doc.server.model: The base model GGUF, relative to the repository root.
_doc.server.port: The port the server listens on; nothing may answer on it before it starts.
_doc.server.ctx_size: The context size (-c): 8192, as in every development, M3 and M5 run.
_doc.server.timeout_s: Seconds the server may take to print its ready line and answer /health.
_doc.server.llama_cpp_build: The build_info the server's /props must report (b11349, as in M3 to M5).
_doc.tokenizer: The model folder whose chat template renders the local prompts and counts the context, relative to the repository root.
_doc.b2: The spending of the cloud model: here ft2r's routed calls, booked under M6.
_doc.b2.max_cost_rmb: What each spending system's single-step and end-to-end runs together may spend, in RMB (5, as in M3 and M5); the preflight checks that the milestone's budget can take it.
_doc.e2e.seed: The seed of every task's run (42, as in M3 and M5).
_doc.e2e.today: The date the tasks run on, YYYY-MM-DD; null for the corpus recording date, as in M3 and M5.
_doc.e2e_routing: How the routed system routes a multi-step task: stepwise (docs/m6-计划.md §3.3 C7: every step decided on its own, a final text answer never routed), unlike M4 and M5's sticky; the end-to-end results are descriptive only.
_doc.statistics: The comparison statistics, as in M3 and M5.
_doc.statistics.seed: The seed of the paired, the cluster and the stratified bootstrap.
_doc.routing: ft2r's frozen routing configuration (scripts/route_curve.py under the cost objective, docs/m6-计划.md §3.3; validated on data/eval/dev-ext.jsonl by scripts/route_validate.py); required when ft2r runs.
_doc.routing.path: The routing file, relative to the repository root.
_doc.routing.sha256: Its SHA-256. The preflight also checks its dev_sha256 against data/eval/dev.jsonl, its adapter_sha256 against adapters.ft2, its rules and chosen policy; the dry run checks ft2r's routed count and successes on the development set against its chosen point.
_doc.reference: The systems of earlier milestones that the comparisons use without running them, their records scored in this session (the development records in a dry run).
_doc.reference.milestone: M3, the block's milestone: its completion markers in data/eval/test-completions.jsonl vouch for the results files of ft and b2; ftr carries its own milestone, M5, whose markers vouch for its file.
_doc.reference.systems.<system>: One reference system: results, its results file of that milestone; records, the per-item records that file was scored from, with records_sha256; dev_records, its development records, with dev_records_sha256; milestone, when it is not the block's.
_doc.comparisons: The preregistered hypotheses (docs/m6-预登记.md): H1 by McNemar and H3 by the stratified one-sided non-inferiority bootstrap, their two p-values Holm-adjusted together in this order; the third and fourth rows (FT2+R2 against B2, H2 withdrawn before the open, and against FT+R) are descriptive, outside the family, with no p.
_doc.comparisons[].name: The comparison's name; results/numbers.json keys its numbers compare.test-m6.<name>.*.
_doc.comparisons[].a: The system compared: the difference is a's success rate minus b's.
_doc.comparisons[].b: The system a is compared with.
_doc.comparisons[].test: mcnemar: the exact McNemar test on the discordant items (H1).
_doc.comparisons[].acebench: H3: the raw ACEBench folders of a (FT2, this milestone) and b (B0, M4), read answer by answer and compared by the stratified bootstrap over the 30 (language, category) strata, with the margin.
_doc.comparisons[].descriptive: true: compared like a tested row (difference, intervals, discordant counts) but outside the Holm family, with no p.
_doc.gpu: The GPU before and during the session (nvidia-smi).
_doc.gpu.idle_max_mib: The most GPU memory in use, in MiB, that still counts as idle at the preflight.
_doc.gpu.sample_ms: The interval of the GPU sampling beside the server, in milliseconds.

purpose: M6: FT2 against FT (H1) and FT2 non-inferior to B0 on ACEBench (H3) on the locked single-step and end-to-end test sets, as preregistered in docs/m6-预登记.md; H2 (FT2+R2 against B2) withdrawn before the open after gate (iii) failed on dev-ext, FT2+R2 descriptive; the third and last open
